items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: The interviewee discusses a person who got busted for marijuana, but the interviewer is the one who explicitly names 'Trumpet Man' and praises him. The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with 'Trumpet Man'.

ctx.x: Yeah, but he got busted down for two years for marijuana. Yeah. See, he didn't want to wet gate, but he'd done something wrong in the night. He caught him with it up in the hotel room. Him and a bunch of them.

Yeah, he knocked them out. Yeah, he knocked them out. He didn't hear nothing of them after that. The basketball. Fine, Trumpet Man, man. Fine. That's good boy. Played just like blues. Fine. Yeah. Yeah. Entertain, tried to sing like blues. Fine. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
The Mexicans didn't smoke marijuana, did they? Hmm? The Mexicans didn't smoke marijuana. Yeah, they generally do. You know, that's the, that's the, they smoke.
